assumptions: Thunder armor needs a high fishing level
The Backwater cloak and belt are kept from the starter gear
The bite time formula changed in the recent fishing speed patch and the new one is not published, so bite time uses the older formula shape and the estimate is rough
Kill time of sea creatures is not modelled because no source gives it, so very strong and very weak setups both look better than a kill limited player will see
Sea creature caps per player and per server are not modelled
Enchants, potions, bait, rod parts and hotspot bonuses are treated as equal across setups and are left out
Pet prices use the cheapest listing of any rarity and level, which can understate the cost of a maxed pet
